claims.text: FPU block mechanics (working labels, no invented semantics): with both guards passed, owner float field +0xE0 := +0.0 (FLDZ; FST). Then if float@0x00A797C8 < owner float +0xE4 (strict, ordered) the copy block runs: owner float +0xE8 := owner float +0xE4 (FLD; FSTP). At the join point 0x00527aeb BOTH paths execute FSTP [EBX+0xE4] := +0.0. Net: field_E0 zeroed always; field_E4 old value moved to field_E8 only when the global float is smaller; field_E4 zeroed always. TEST AH,0x5 / JP is the MSVC jump-if-not-less idiom: JP taken when C0=C2 (both clear -> st0>src, st0==src via C3, or both set -> unordered/NaN), NOT taken only when st0<src.
claims.premise: x87 condition codes after FCOMP: ST0>src -> C3,C2,C0=000; ST0<src -> C0=1; ST0==src -> C3=1,C0=C2=0; unordered -> C0=C2=C3=1. TEST AH,0x5 masks C0 (AH bit0) and C2 (AH bit2); PF=even parity of the masked result; JP taken iff (C0,C2) in {00,11}. FLDZ pushes +0.0; FST stores without pop; FSTP stores and pops.
claims.claim_resolution: COMPLETE (mechanical); semantic meaning of the three float fields and of global 0x00A797C8: UNKNOWN (working labels owner_float_E0/E4/E8, global_float_A797C8; value of the global not in evidence)

claims.premise: x87 push/pop depth accounting per instruction (FLD/FLDZ push; FST no pop; FSTP/FCOMP pop).
